name: forward-deploy-engineer-learning
description: A hands-on, enterprise-grade project for mastering Forward Deployed Engineering skills: - **Domain Modeling & Ubiquitous Language**: Clean separation between business domain and technical artifacts. - **Document & Data Ingestion**: Handling messy real-world contracts, PDFs, and ISO certifications. - **Hybrid RAG & Exact Citation Engine**: Dense + Sparse BM25 retrieval with strict source provenance (no hallucination without citation). - **Compliance Rule Engine**: Schema-enforced evaluation (Pass, Flagged, Inconclusive). - **Agentic Triage & State Machine**: Routing cases to human operators via canonical 5-role triage vocabulary. - **Operator Action Workspace**: Operational interface for review, audit trail, and determination.
